purpose: One fixed capped operation-weighted BC fit using the previously sealed teacher-choice training sample.
hypothesis: Counter class imbalance with min(2,sqrt(N/(5*n_selected_operation))); no test outcome selects weights.
controlled: Same old archive, schema, initial/training seed, group order, candidate packing, optimizer, 128 updates and recorded WSL software as the prior fit; only group loss weights differ in the copied trainer.
acceptance: One archive snapshot, exact old selected-operation counts/seed roles, 128 synchronized GPU updates with nonzero gradient and changed weights, 16-group CPU/GPU parity, independent review and confirmed Windows transport plus Linux session cleanup.
resources: Three 4GiB host-memory samples before marker; host 2GiB sampled cancellation floor, separate Linux process-group guard, bounded time and one attempt; no claim of GPU memory hard cap.
stop_conditions: After fit-start marker any identity/resource/fit/cleanup failure stops without retry or replacement. Before marker low-memory preflight reads no cache.
boundaries: No failed-panel trace, new official game, old holdout result selection, automatic model promotion, PPO or changes to frozen trainer/default Bot/driver. Checkpoint and local logs remain private.
provenance: Independent subagent advice and review, not WebChat.
